part.text:
The robot has reached the end of the corridor and is now resting in front of the green panel. The sonar reads about 0.67 m to the panel. The last camera image shows the panel filling the view.

The corridor ran straight, then turned left, then turned left again. The panel was at the end of that last stretch.
